title: Digital Nitrogen Tyre Inflator
description: Advanced tyre inflation system that provides precise nitrogen filling with digital control for optimal tyre performance and longevity.
features: Dual functionality for both air and nitrogen inflation

benefits: Maintains tyre pressure longer than compressed air
Reduces tyre wear and extends tyre life
More consistent tyre pressure in varying temperatures
